concerns.text: Task T011 bundles the entire full‑evaluation pipeline (baseline & dynamic runs, metric computation, statistical testing, figure generation) into a single unchecked task. This is overly coarse for the task‑atomizer; it should be split into finer‑grained subtasks (e.g., separate tasks for baseline generation, dynamic generation, metric calculation, statistical testing, and figure creation) to ensure deterministic verification and clearer traceability.

Task T001 is a scaffolding/setup task that does not map to any functional requirement or success criterion in the spec. While executable, it is an orphan task lacking traceability to FR/SC items, which may cause unnecessary CI overhead. Consider either linking it to a concrete requirement (e.g., FR‑001 prerequisite) or removing it.
